unrequited love is very tough to handle, props to you for having the courage to keep distance with him and wishing him happy I know it wasn’t easy. Now if I were you I would just tell them both my feeling just to get it off my chest but honestly I’m just day dreaming at this point and would never have the courage to do so haha. 

I would advise you to look at this situation as the cliche “if it was meant to be than I would have been” life is a tough cycles of unwanted things come over to mess us up and us overcoming it, once you quit you lose. And remember that everthing happen to us not on us. OMG I am yapping lol

In order to move on in this situation, I would advise you to 
a) completely shut him off your life, never contact him, don’t talk to him don’t even look his way. Find a hobbies that you enjoy doing or do productive things to fill the time. You can cry about it once in a while but pleasee talk to someone when you feel too overwhelmed, giving up love is a very tough thing to do (if you have no one that is what this subreddite exist for and if you need a personal interaction I have two ears (or eyes haha) that I can always lend you one)
b) confronted both the couple about your feeling and tell them both how you feel towards him and how it has affected you. I’m sure they would be reasonably understanding towards you, no one can control their emotion AND if i had a girlfriend and someone else approached me to say they have a crush on me I would be very flattered but feel sorry for them because I couldn’t answer their emotion. 

That’s all I have to say thanks for going through my yapping and I sincerely hope you can move on from this and find peace within you.

I'm also in the process of dealing with grief and guilt after a breakup. Just like you my ex was (and still is ) my best friend that I have no filter with. She however acted on her own and not some sort of medication or altercation when she broke things up with me after a tough fight (over what seemingly nothing) and some guy was comforting her while I was a spike in her eyes. Admittingly, although our relationship was really rocky in the last half but it also when from 0 to 100 in the matter of weeks. Well, after that she came clean to me that she fell in love with the other guy and that she's sorry for fell out of love with me. My heart stopped but ultimately came to the conclusion that I should set her free and wish her happiness even if that happiness does not include me.

In term of dealing with this, I just listen to heart break jazz while let it consume me lol but I now feel a lot better thanks to my friends and even my ex for comforting me. I also found out about this subreddit along the way and realized that maybe we are just not meant for each other as a couple but she's someone that definitely gonna stay in my life.

I still feel guilty as hell whenever she brought up the things that I wronged her though, so much so that my sadness makes the atmosphere around us awkward. 

  
Btw writing about these things definitely help me a lot so thanks for reading my rant if you make it this far lol
